bluf: Croud is an independent scaled performance agency, UK and New York on record, 600+ experts in the Croud Group plus a 2,900+ on demand Croudie network, selling measurement first (Return on Intelligence) and media, commerce and SEO through its CroudOS platform and Croud Intelligence products. The record shows it consolidating that platform story: Campaign Global Independent Media Agency of the Year 2025, a Nestlé Nespresso MMM award, and 2026 MPB cases on in-housing and first party data. A rival should know it sells paid search while running no Google ads of its own, has no public pricing model, and 10 of its 14 clients on record are names only.
doing:
The positioning line, an independent global media, creative and data agency delivering Return on Intelligence through its CroudOS platform, Croudie on demand network and incrementality focused measurement, decodes as a media agency that sells the measurement and the operating system as the product and the channels as what runs on them. The headline claim, quoted as a claim, is Campaign Global's Independent Media Agency of the Year 2025, with 600+ experts plus 2,900 on demand specialists in 118 markets.

One lead line scores 3, Data & Measurement: the H1 promises Return on Intelligence, with incrementality focused measurement, AttributionGeni and MediaGeni tools and the Nespresso MMM award. Five core lines score 2: AI Automation / Agents (CroudOS runs delivery through Croud Intelligence products, CreativeCI engineers creative before launch, the Commerce Suite is billed AI powered), Paid Search (the MPB case fed first party CRM data into Search Ads 360 bidding, lifting ROAS 35% and AOV 21%), Programmatic & CTV (the Media Suite, DarwinCI), Retail Media (Commerce Suite with retail media, Amazon and FeedCI pages) and SEO (SEOCI, with Organic Performance named a core area). Proprietary products on record: CroudOS, the CI products BrandCI, CreativeCI, DarwinCI, FeedCI and SEOCI, AttributionGeni, MediaGeni, SearchAnywhere, the Croudie network and The Croud Consumer Index. No partners are listed.

AI posture in plain terms: Return on Intelligence, CroudOS and the CI products for audience, creative, media and AI powered commerce, plus published ChatGPT ads guidance; the move read marks P8 making and P1 partial, with no audited AI visibility product shown. Pricing signals: none. The one dated move is the 2025 Campaign award; case studies carry lastmod dates from 2025-09-03 (Duke Cannon, Kerzner) to 2026-06-23 (MPB). Conspicuously absent for a scaled media agency: a founded year or HQ city, jobs and news on record, and an owned audience line.
clients:
The record describes a mixed client type across retail and ecommerce, flexible workspace, restaurants, media and streaming, consumer brands and charity, with the UK and New York as home markets; the book on record is 14 names, 4 observed and 10 named only, from 2 case studies, 1 award entry and 11 slugs.

The observed four: MPB, coded commerce (N7) on the title How Croud helped MPB de-risk in-housing and deliver 25% YoY revenue growth, with a second case on first party data lifting ROAS 35%; Thorne, coded AI and organic (N9, N1) on Growing AI search visibility for Thorne; First Watch, coded social (N8) on an Influencer Marketing case study; and Nestlé Nespresso, coded organic (N1) from an award entry in the LinkedIn ads, though the award named is Best Use of Media Mix Modeling, a data need. The IWG case title reads profitable demand led growth at global scale but is coded named only. Timberland, Duke Cannon, Kerzner, Maybourne, Creed, BritBox, Skillshare, Royal British Legion and Regus are slugs with no described work, needs inferred from the media mix; one LinkedIn ad names Banza as a client, which the needs read does not carry.

No client sits on another tracked agency's book; 10 of 14 are names only, which the openings read flags as thin evidence.

As a judgment, the Horus read places Croud best for KJ4 (the platforms are absorbing the execution layer) and KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better), both driven by Data & Measurement, and most exposed to KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two) through programmatic and paid social. Its consumer and ecommerce clients are likely to keep buying incrementality and MMM from it and to push media hours toward automation, the direction its CroudOS story already points; moderate confidence.
house: Say and do: 1 of 2 tested lines practised on its own house. Paid Search is contradicted: it sells paid search and runs no Google ads of its own; the Transparency Center holds 1 text ad for the domain under the advertiser ANGIN KHACHATRYAN, status not found. Publishing cadence is corroborated: the sitemap lists 530 URLs, 13 updated in 90 days and 34 in 365 days, with 6 AI topic URLs. llms.txt is absent (false) and no AI crawlers are blocked. LinkedIn advertising is active: 24 company page ads on the first page of 71 matching the name query, the count a floor, samples celebrating Gold in the Independent Media category and the Nestlé Nespresso Best Use of Media Mix Modeling win. Meta and TikTok status is not recorded. The tag stack is gtm, hubspot and onetrust, no CMS recorded, no social pixels, test tools or ABM stack. Social links: LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X and Facebook.
market:
The Horus read scores Croud 20.4 on the tailwind index, 71st percentile, band Favored, sold mix at 16:16 on the Solar Arc, afternoon (Ra to Atum), resilience 38.2. Best placed for KJ4 (the platforms are absorbing the execution layer) and KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better), both carried by Data & Measurement against negative media drivers. Most exposed to KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two), driven by Programmatic & CTV and Paid Social. Best fit: The Walled Oasis, 47/100. Moves: P4 and P8 making; P1, P2 and P6 partial; P7 absent; P5 unknown; P3 not applicable.

Monsoon: 53.3, band Breeze, 40th percentile, migration 50.3 against displacement 56.3. The verdict says 45 of the index is the sold mix, SEO (11) and Data & Measurement (8) carrying the most movable hours; shore 50% South and Southeast Asia, 40% Eastern Europe; automation overlaps 21% of the movable hours. Evidence class observed; no hub offices or onshore claims are listed, and the Croudie on demand network is the delivery footprint the record describes, with no location given.
openings:
The strongest opening is the paid search contradiction: Croud sells paid search, evidences it with the MPB Search Ads 360 case, and runs no Google ads of its own in the Transparency Center. A rival whose own search account is visible can likely lead with that against a house selling measurement rigour (moderate confidence: it may buy under another advertiser name). Falsifier: Croud appearing as advertiser in the Transparency Center at the next compile.

No public pricing model exists, so an outcome priced media offer is a conversation it cannot have in public, against a firm whose whole pitch is Return on Intelligence (likely). Its KJ5 exposure sits in programmatic and paid social hours, and paid social scores only 1, so a social specialist very likely takes that line from the mixed book. It sells AI search at score 1 with no audited AI visibility product, so a rival leading with the citation number wins the Thorne style conversation (likely). Ten of 14 clients are names only, questions to ask rather than stories to counter. Monsoon reads Breeze with displacement 56.3, so price matters to part of the book but does not carry a pitch alone.
watch: Indicator I7, holiday 2026 agentic checkout volume and merchant opt out rates, next reading December 2026 to January 2027: disclosed AI checkout GMV would strengthen KJ4, the judgment Croud is best placed for, and its AI powered Commerce Suite.

Indicator I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the next milestone ($2B) and pricing below $20 CPM bear on the ChatGPT ads guidance it publishes and the assistant ad tests P8 says it is making.

The dated move to follow up is the 2026-06-23 MPB in-housing case: an agency selling in-housing support is a signal on how it prices hours, and the next case index update would show whether that offer spreads.
The next Radar compile after 2026-09-28 refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients; a Croud advertiser record in the Transparency Center or an llms.txt would change the house read.
